notes: On LG TVs, a film whose only sound is DTS — which those TVs cannot play — is marked before you pick it, and with Nebula open on a Windows or Linux computer that is sharing with the TV, its sound is converted to Dolby Digital Plus there while the picture, 4K and HDR included, passes through untouched. A film with DTS and a Dolby track plays as it is. Play through your PC also works with more kinds of files.
